title: Primo Levi
summary: Primo Levi, a chemist born in Turin on 31 July 1919, joined the partisans and was arrested in December 1943. He was deported from Fossoli to Auschwitz in February 1944 and held at Monowitz, was liberated on 27 January 1945, and returned to Turin in October 1945. He wrote If This Is a Man (1947) and The Truce (1963) and died in Turin in 1987.

uncertainty.note: Birth 31 July 1919; death 11 April 1987 per the Davidson Institute page.

audience_note: Refers to the Holocaust, Auschwitz and a death that the coroner ruled a suicide, though some friends believe it an accident.
